title: MAX98357A Amplifier Pinout
description: Students will identify each pin and component on the MAX98357A I2S amplifier breakout board and explain what it does in the audio circuit.
creator: Dan McCreary STEM Robots
subject: Robotics
Physical Computing
Audio Electronics
MicroPython
bloomLevel: Understand (L2) — Explain the purpose of each pin on the MAX98357A amplifier board.

educational.subjectArea: STEM Robotics / Physical Computing / Audio Electronics
learningObjectives: Students will identify each pin and component on the MAX98357A amplifier board.
Students will explain why the speaker terminal, the amplifier chip, and each of the seven header pins are needed to make sound.
educational.bloomTaxonomy: Understand (L2) — Explain the purpose of each pin on the MAX98357A amplifier board.
educational.prerequisites: Familiarity with the MAX98357A Amp Kit and basic I2S/digital-audio vocabulary from the kit's lessons.

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-explore callout overlay on a real photo of the board, with an optional quiz mode
pedagogical.rationale: Letting students hover each real pin/pad on an actual photo of the board (rather than a schematic) ties the abstract signal names (BCLK, LRC, DIN, GAIN, SD) to the physical solder pads they will actually wire before they touch the hardware.
pedagogical.assessment: Quiz mode asks students to identify each labeled part from its visual hint alone.
